selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What new part of creation was opened to the traveler after he reflected on the mountains and plains?
questions.answer: The world of trees and plants was opened to him.

questions.question: What did that realm seem like to him in a spiritual sense?
questions.answer: It seemed like a beautiful gathering declaring Allah’s unity and thanking Him.

questions.question: Did he see only one type of plant giving this message, or many kinds together?
questions.answer: He saw many different kinds together giving the same message.

questions.question: What is the central claim that these plants and trees support?
questions.answer: They support the truth that there is no god but Allah.

questions.question: What does the first proof teach through the blessings seen in plants?
questions.answer: It teaches that their gifts and benefits come through purposeful generosity.

questions.question: What does the first truth suggest about the source of these blessings?
questions.answer: It suggests they come from a giver who acts intentionally and generously.

questions.question: What does this careful variety show about the One who made them?
questions.answer: It shows that their Maker is wise and creates with purpose.

questions.question: What qualities mark the growth of these plants from seeds?
questions.answer: Their growth shows order, balance, beauty, life, and purpose.

questions.question: What would weaken this proof, and what does the passage say instead?
questions.answer: Frequent errors would weaken it, but the passage says this growth happens without mistake.

questions.question: How does the traveler’s praise at the end fit the rest of the passage?
questions.answer: It is his thankful response after seeing strong signs that deepen his faith.

questions.question: While traveling in his thoughts, what realm did the traveler enter next?
questions.answer: He entered the realm of vegetation and trees.

questions.question: When he looked at that realm, what kind of gathering did he seem to see?
questions.answer: He saw it as a beautiful gathering praising Allah and showing His unity.

questions.question: Which plant features are presented like voices or expressions of this truth?
questions.answer: The leaves, flowers, and fruits.

questions.question: What shared message do the species of trees and plants communicate?
questions.answer: They communicate that Allah alone is the true God.

questions.question: What is the first of the three major truths?
questions.answer: Blessings and generous giving appear clearly in individual plants and across all plants.

questions.question: What is the second major proof found in the many kinds of plants?
questions.answer: Their differences, decoration, and special forms are wise and intentional, not due to chance.

questions.question: According to the third truth, what is surprising about the relationship between seeds and full-grown plants?
questions.answer: Very simple and similar seeds produce many different living forms with order and beauty.

questions.question: Why are seeds important in the third proof?
questions.answer: They show that many different forms begin from small, limited, similar starting points.

questions.question: What qualities stay present while these different plants develop?
questions.answer: Exact order, balanced proportion, beauty, life, and purpose remain present.

questions.question: What blessing does the traveler mention at the end?
questions.answer: He mentions the blessing of having belief.

questions.question: What did the trees and plants invite the traveler to do?
questions.answer: They invited him to enter their realm and examine its signs carefully.

questions.question: What did he learn from simply looking at the condition of trees and plants?
questions.answer: He learned that they were all pointing to Allah’s greatness and oneness.

questions.question: How does the traveler describe the plant world as a whole?
questions.answer: He sees it as a beautiful and orderly gathering centered on Allah’s unity and praise.

questions.question: In the third truth, what begins as alike but ends up very different?
questions.answer: Seeds that are similar produce plants that are distinct from one another.
